name: boostopt-vscode
description: Verified, correct-and-faster C++ optimizations in your editor. Every suggestion is proven behavior-identical before it is ever shown.

boostopt.command.description: Command to run the boostopt CLI. Use 'boostopt' if installed, or e.g. 'python3 -m boostopt.surfaces.cli' to run from a checkout.

boostopt.args.markdownDescription:
Extra flags passed to `boostopt optimize`, your choice. Anything from `boostopt optimize --help` works, e.g.:

```json
["--model", "local", "--min-rung", "1", "--metamorphic", "--fuzz", "5000", "--budget", "$1"]
```

Project policy is best kept in `.boostopt.toml` (shared with the CLI & CI); use this for editor-specific overrides. The extension always adds `--json`.

boostopt.compileCommands.description: Convenience for the common `-p` flag: path to compile_commands.json (optional; or just put '-p <path>' in boostopt.args).
